mentions.name: Books search service
mentions.description: An attempted books search service meant to surface at-a-glance book information — genres and Storygraph-style 'moods', number of pages, series membership, ratings across services, and cost — drawn from Storygraph and Goodreads; it never worked properly.
mentions.problem: No good books search service provided the at-a-glance information needed from Storygraph and Goodreads.
mentions.source_excerpt: I attempted something like this because I wanted a good books search service which provided me at-a-glance information I needed from Storygraph & Goodreads.
